releases/latest.name: NodeSight 1.8.4
releases/latest.body:
## NodeSight 1.8.4

### Fixes
- **Leatrix Plus**. With Leatrix Plus' square minimap, the minimap no longer shows up under your mouse and jumps around during a scan. The same goes for other addons that keep their own minimap shape

+    -- Each frame of a scan: frames that faded in (an addon's buttons shown on the minimap's

+    local function KeepHidden(s)

+    -- Mappy fades its minimap buttons in while the minimap is hovered, as it is in a scan,

+    -- Clicks and hover can't be given back to a protected frame in a fight: a scan that

+                if ok and protected then return true end

meaningfulChanges: 1.8.2 empty-mask hiding instead of alpha to avoid terrain streaks, additional addon/hover/controller compatibility, public NodeSightAPI scanning-result callbacks
1.8.3 Mappy/TomTom/minimap button visual compatibility; full restart needed for new EmptyMask asset
assessment.validation: Source/read-only official metadata only; no install, no game verification, no addon or website edits.
assessment.automationUpdated: Preserved daily10 schedule; now requires names+sound only, no native map movement/scale/hide, and explicit user testing approval before publication.
